sections.heading: We start with how you work

Our business analysts sit with your team and map that work as it really happens. Then our engineers automate the parts a machine should do, and leave the decisions with your people.

tasks.name: Matching invoices to payments
tasks.today: Someone downloads the bank statement, opens each invoice and ticks off the payments by hand in a spreadsheet.

tasks.name: Building the weekly report
tasks.today: Every Monday someone exports data from three systems, pastes it into Excel, fixes the formulas and emails a PDF.

steps.text: Pulls the numbers from each system on a schedule
Checks for gaps and unusual changes
Updates a live Power BI dashboard and emails a short summary
Reads the summary and decides what to do

tasks.result: The report is ready before the Monday meeting, every week.
tasks.built_with: Business analysis and data intelligence, with Power BI and Python

Takes over anything unusual, with the full history in front of them

tasks.result: Your team spends its time on the questions that need a person.

case_studies.title: AI business assistant
case_studies.tagline: An assistant that handles customer questions and internal requests
case_studies.description: An AI assistant that automates customer conversations, ticket routing and internal knowledge lookups.
case_studies.challenge: The client received more than 8,000 customer queries a month, with an average response time of 14 hours and high costs across several support desks.
case_studies.solution: We built a secure retrieval-augmented assistant connected to the client's documentation, CRM and ticketing systems, able to carry out routine actions on its own.
results: 78% of support tickets resolved without a person stepping in
Average response time down from 14 hours to 8 seconds
Customer satisfaction up from 3.6 to 4.9 out of 5

case_studies.title: Retail analytics dashboard
case_studies.tagline: One view of sales and stock for a multi-store retail chain
case_studies.description: A business intelligence dashboard with sales, stock and performance for more than 120 stores, with alerts.
case_studies.challenge: Leadership relied on weekly spreadsheets from each store. Reordering was slow, items ran out of stock and sales were lost.
case_studies.solution: A Power BI suite with automatic daily imports from the tills, stock-out alerts and margin analysis by product.
results: 45 manager hours a week no longer spent assembling spreadsheets
Gross margin up 3.2% through better markdowns

case_studies.title: Automated data pipeline
case_studies.tagline: A pipeline that moves more than 10 million events a day
case_studies.description: An automated ETL pipeline that collects, transforms and delivers data to the compliance, risk and marketing teams.
case_studies.challenge: Old batch jobs regularly crashed during the morning load, so compliance officers worked with stale data and transactions were delayed.
case_studies.solution: A self-scaling pipeline on Snowflake and dbt with automatic data quality checks, schema change handling and Slack alerts.
results: Pipeline delay down from 6 hours to 4 minutes
Data freshness targets met for every regulatory audit

case_studies.title: Business management application
case_studies.tagline: One platform for jobs, drivers, invoices and customers
case_studies.description: A custom application that brings daily operations, dispatch, invoicing and client communication into one place.
case_studies.challenge: The business used six disconnected tools. Data was typed in twice, deliveries were missed and invoices went out late.
case_studies.solution: One web application with job scheduling, live driver tracking, automatic PDF invoices and a customer portal.
results: Six software subscriptions replaced by one platform
Invoices sent immediately instead of after 12 days

faqs.question: Who owns the code and the models?
faqs.answer: You do. Once the final invoice is paid, you own all the code, trained models, prompt templates and database designs we created for your project.

faqs.question: Will our data be used to train AI models?
faqs.answer: No. We set up AI services with zero data retention, so your data is never used to train public models. We never sell or share your information.

faqs.question: Will you sign an NDA?
faqs.answer: Yes. We sign a non-disclosure agreement before we look at your systems or your data.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Most projects follow our five stages and go live in about ten weeks. We confirm the timeline in the project plan before any work starts.

faqs.question: How do you agree scope and cost?
faqs.answer: Every project has a written statement of work with milestones and acceptance criteria, so the scope, the timeline and the cost are clear before we begin.

faqs.question: How do we follow progress?
faqs.answer: You see working software at a demo every two weeks, and you can talk to the engineers directly in a shared Slack or Teams channel.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: We monitor the system, fix problems, retrain models when their accuracy drifts and add features as you grow. Live systems get 24/7 priority support.

faqs.question: Can you work with the tools we already use?
faqs.answer: Yes. We connect to your existing ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, databases and cloud through APIs, SFTP or direct database connections.

faqs.question: Which industries do you work with?
faqs.answer: Retail, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, education, logistics and fast-growing startups. The problems are similar everywhere: repeated tasks, scattered data and slow reports.

faqs.question: Where are you based?
faqs.answer: In Bengaluru, India. We work Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00 IST.

faqs.question: How do we start?
faqs.answer: Book a free consultation. We talk through the work you want to automate, then send you a short plan for how we would do it.

policies.title: Privacy policy
policies.summary: We respect your data privacy. We collect only what is essential to respond to your consultation requests, scope custom AI projects and provide our engineering services.

blocks.heading: Information we collect
blocks.text: When you submit forms on our website or book a consultation, we collect your name, work email address, phone number, company name and project description.

blocks.heading: No training on your data
blocks.text: We never sell, rent or share your contact or project information with third-party advertisers. All AI endpoints we set up are configured with strict zero data retention, so your proprietary data is never used to train public foundation models.

policies.title: Terms of service
policies.summary: By using the Algorudix website or engaging our consulting and development services, you agree to these clear and transparent terms.

blocks.heading: 100% intellectual property ownership
blocks.text: Upon final payment for contracted deliverables, clients retain 100% intellectual property ownership of all bespoke code, trained model weights, prompt templates and custom database schemas created specifically for their engagement.

blocks.heading: Project scoping and delivery milestones
blocks.text: All software development and data analysis projects run under formal statements of work with defined milestone acceptance criteria, regular sprint demos and transparent timelines.

policies.title: Security
policies.summary: Security is part of every layer of our engineering work, from private cloud deployments to automated security scanning in our CI/CD pipelines.

blocks.heading: Data encryption
blocks.text: AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit for all client data streams and API integrations.

blocks.heading: Isolated AI pipelines
blocks.text: Enterprise OpenAI, Azure and AWS endpoints are configured with zero retention, so your proprietary data stays yours.
